{{Quote|And I'd like to chain you to a bantha and drag you across fifty kilometers of dart flowers and meateating plants until you're just a stain.|[[Han Solo]], to [[Thrackan Sal-Solo]]|<ref name="Betrayal">''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]''</ref>}}
'''Dart flowers''' were a tall [[Sentience/Legends|semi-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Plant/Legends|plant]] that grew on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. Either corrupted by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] or produced by [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]], the aggressive flora populated the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] world's [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] and [[Dark Force Temple]]. When any creatures passed near them, the [[Color/Legends|red]] flowers fired poisonous barbs from their blue centers to kill their prey,<ref name="MOTS" /> and once dead, the carnivorous plant consumed them.<ref name="Betrayal" /> If hurt by their prey or any predators, the plants cried out.<ref name="MOTS" />

In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC">According to the opening crawl, ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'' takes place five [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]] after the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''Jedi Knight'' to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. Therefore, we can deduce that ''Mysteries of the Sith'' takes place in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].</ref> [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Reciprocal apprenticeship|apprentice]] to [[Kyle Katarn]],<ref name="DS1">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050407a|serieslink=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 1}}</ref> encountered dart flowers on her [[Mission to Dromund Kaas (New Republic)|mission]] to save her friend and apprentice from the sinister Temple.<ref name="MOTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|These semi-intelligent plants fire deadly darts to kill prey.|''Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith'' instruction manual|<ref name="MOTS" />}}
Dart flowers first appeared in the [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'',<ref name="MOTS" /> and according to the project leader, [[Stephen Shaw]],<ref name="FAQ">{{LucasArts|url=products/sith/sith_faq.htm|text=Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith - FAQ}}</ref> [[LucasArts]] created the flowers for the game.<ref name="Feat">{{LucasArts|url=products/sith/sith_features.htm|text=Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith - Features}}</ref>
